activity_summary: At home you washed the flour off and refused the boast. You were more fearful a fortnight ago. Tonight you are not. The horses were real. The gallery was Richard's.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Washed, and would not invent a tremble.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: mentioned in Flour, and not a boast

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The fortnight had it, when the cold did;
